answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 9 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 380 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. The river of the design is public, the yarrow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the reef of honest work is what finally pays.
